name: Project list and details
summary: The project list on web and mobile (badges, counts, chips, filters, search and order) and the project overview and details.

roles.note: The list shows only projects the user is assigned to (directly or through a group), plus company scope for super-admins.

actions.action: View the project list and overview

nfr.statement: Time to load the project list for a user with many projects, on web and mobile.
nfr.open_question: What p95 is acceptable, and for how many projects (enterprise users can see hundreds)?

requirements.title: Construction phase and access stage are shown separately
requirements.statement: The web list returns the construction phase, the status and the derived access stage as separate fields. The card's badge is worked out again in the web app: - an approved project with no designs shows New - an approved project with designs shows In-construction (both unless the phase is Pre-bid) - Draft and Pending approval show their status - otherwise the phase is shown, or Completed if it's missing
open_checks: Updating a card locally uses other defaults (a design count of 0 shows New, a count of 0 users falls back to the users list), which can briefly differ from the full list

acceptance_criteria.given: An approved project with no designs and no construction phase set
acceptance_criteria.when: It appears in the web list

acceptance_criteria.given: A project with status Completed and no phase
acceptance_criteria.when: It appears in the web list

requirements.title: Mobile and web have different project list contracts
requirements.statement: Mobile and web call different list endpoints. The pinned mobile response has no construction phase, and adds role, counts and design summaries. A user has reported a newer, trimmed mobile response with only the access stage; which route and build that comes from is not identified.
open_checks: Tie the reported trimmed mobile response to a specific route and app build; native mobile source was not inspected

acceptance_criteria.when: A mobile client requests the list
acceptance_criteria.then: Each item has status, address, role and counts, but no construction phase

requirements.title: What a mobile project card summarises
requirements.statement: A mobile project card shows the first five active, non-support users plus a total count. Its "last updated" date comes from the latest active snapshot with an active reality. "Has progress" means the project has categories and at least one eligible design; it doesn't mean any progress was measured.

acceptance_criteria.given: A project with categories, one eligible design and no measured progress

requirements.title: One structure status chip, by precedence
requirements.statement: Each structure shows at most one status chip, chosen in this order: New, Error, Processing, No Design, No Reality. A higher chip hides any lower condition that is also true.

acceptance_criteria.given: A structure with a design in error and no reality
acceptance_criteria.then: It shows Error, not No Reality

requirements.title: Project list filters, search and order
requirements.statement: Lifecycle filters (Draft, Pending approval, Need revision, Archived, Initiated) match the stored status, while In-construction and other filters match the construction phase. New means approved with no designs. Capture-date filters compare dates in the project's time zone and include both ends. Search matches name, stage and city. Favourites always come first.
open_checks: These are older cached-main semantics; confirm the current web release before relying on them

acceptance_criteria.given: A favourite project last updated in January and a non-favourite updated today
acceptance_criteria.when: The list is sorted by last updated
acceptance_criteria.then: The favourite is still listed first

requirements.title: Filter by Need revision and Pending approval
requirements.statement: The project list can be filtered to projects that need revision or are pending approval.

acceptance_criteria.given: Projects in Approved, Pending approval and Need revision
acceptance_criteria.when: The user filters by Need revision
acceptance_criteria.then: Only the Need revision projects are shown

requirements.title: Edit details and open the map from the overview
requirements.statement: Users can edit project details directly from the project overview, and open the project location map in a new window.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user with update-project-details on the overview
acceptance_criteria.when: They edit and save the project details

acceptance_criteria.then: An interactive map opens in a new window

requirements.title: User counts refresh in the background and can be stale
requirements.statement: Project user counts are recalculated in the background after changes. A missing result becomes zero, and a failed refresh is only logged, so counts can be stale. Counts are for display and never decide access.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user is added to a project and the count refresh fails
acceptance_criteria.then: (Current behaviour) The old count is shown, and the user still has access
